name: Slider

props.name: ariaLabelInput
props.description: The `ariaLabel` for the `<input>`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: `true` to disable this slider.

props.name: formatLabel
props.description: The callback to format the label associated with the minimum/maximum value and the value tooltip when hideTextInput is true.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Specify whether you want the underlying label to be visually hidden

props.name: hideTextInput
props.description: `true` to hide the number input box.

props.name: inputType
props.description: The `type` attribute of the `<input>`.

props.name: invalid
props.description: `Specify whether the Slider is currently invalid

props.name: invalidText
props.description: Provide the text that is displayed when the Slider is in an invalid state

props.name: labelText
props.description: The label for the slider.

props.name: light
props.description: `true` to use the light version.

props.name: max
props.description: The maximum value.

props.name: maxLabel
props.description: The label associated with the maximum value.

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum value.

props.name: minLabel
props.description: The label associated with the minimum value.

props.name: name
props.description: The `name` attribute of the `<input>`.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the slider should be read-only

props.name: required
props.description: `true` to specify if the control is required.

props.name: step
props.description: A value determining how much the value should increase/decrease by moving the thumb by mouse. If a value other than 1 is provided and the input is *not* hidden, the new step requirement should be added to a visible label. Values outside the `step` increment will be considered invalid.

props.name: stepMultiplier
props.description: A value determining how much the value should increase/decrease by Shift+arrow keys, which will be `(max - min) / stepMultiplier`.

props.name: unstable_ariaLabelInputUpper
props.description: The `ariaLabel` for the upper bound `<input>` and handle when there are two handles.

props.name: unstable_nameUpper
props.description: The `name` attribute of the upper bound `<input>` when there are two handles.

props.name: unstable_valueUpper
props.description: The upper bound when there are two handles.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the slider. When there are two handles, value is the lower bound.

props.name: warn
props.description: Specify whether the Slider is in a warning state.

props.name: warnText
props.description: Provide the text displayed when the Slider is in a warning state.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon Slider rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
